headline: High risk of data leakage and cascading errors: Windsurf can read/write local workspace files while Notion AI shares workspace state and can ingest workspace content.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Windsurf can read and write local workspace files and uses clipboard/MCP surfaces, while Notion AI operates over shared workspace pages and team knowledge base content. That creates a plausible content-to-instruction bridge if either agent consumes the other's generated text as trusted input. The pathway is not proven by docs, so I choose medium over low because shared workspace state is explicit.
conditions: IF Windsurf reads Notion-generated text from a shared workspace file or clipboard as instructions
IF Notion AI is prompted with content originating from Windsurf without provenance checks
mitigations: Separate the agents into different workspaces or folders
Disable clipboard-based handoff between the tools
Require a human review step before copying agent output into the other agent
Use provenance labels in shared files
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization or instruction-stripping at the handoff boundary

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content, and Windsurf reads workspace files with broad network egress and model-proxy/MCP access. If the same sensitive documents are present in the shared workspace, Windsurf can expose them to external services. The pair therefore has a default shared-data leakage path, though not enough evidence for high because uncontrolled third-party exfiltration is not explicitly documented.
conditions: IF sensitive workspace pages are also present as local files in Windsurf's workspace
IF Windsurf sends file contents through its model proxy or MCP-connected services
mitigations: Move sensitive docs out of the shared workspace
Restrict Windsurf to a non-sensitive subdirectory
Turn off or narrow MCP servers
Review which files Notion AI can access before sharing them
requires-engineering: enforce per-tool data-loss-prevention controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Notion AI has shared workspace state across instances, while Windsurf has local-filesystem sharing and unrestricted write capability. Both can modify overlapping workspace content, and neither profile shows locking or coordination. That matches the high-risk pattern of concurrent writes to the same mutable area, with possible irreversible git or file corruption if Windsurf operates on synced workspace files.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same workspace-backed files or synced documents
IF Windsurf edits files that Notion AI also updates in the same session window
mitigations: Assign each agent a separate working directory
Pause one agent while the other is editing shared files
Use version control checkpoints before edits
Avoid letting Windsurf auto-apply changes in shared paths
requires-engineering: add file-level locking or merge arbitration

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, and Windsurf can act on file contents through its agentic editor loop. If Windsurf treats Notion output as authoritative, errors can cascade from generated prose into code or file edits. The docs do not prove automatic trust, so medium is appropriate rather than high.
conditions: IF Windsurf uses Notion AI output as source material for edits without verification
IF Notion AI summarizes incorrect workspace facts that Windsurf then operationalizes
mitigations: Require a verification step before applying Notion-derived facts
Keep Notion output in a review-only note
Ask Windsurf to cite original source files before editing
Limit agent autonomy on downstream actions
requires-engineering: add structured provenance checks between agents

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI is workspace-content oriented, while Windsurf handles source code, open files, and model-provider keys. If regulated or confidential data is stored in the shared workspace, the pair can create retention and residency mismatches across vendor-hosted Notion processing and Windsurf's broader network/model-proxy flow. The profiles do not specify a formal DPA or residency boundary, so uncertainty pushes this to medium.
conditions: IF regulated data is placed in Notion workspace pages and also opened in Windsurf
IF organizational policy requires residency or retention controls not documented in either profile
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both tools
Use separate tenants or workspaces for sensitive content
Review vendor retention settings before use
Avoid storing secrets in files opened by Windsurf
requires-engineering: document and enforce a data-processing agreement and retention policy
